name: dyaddown
expr: yv = dyaddown(v); zv = dyaddown(v, 1); yM = dyaddown(M); ymc = dyaddown(M, 0, 'c'); ymr = dyaddown(M, 0, 'r'); ymm = dyaddown(M, 0, 'm'); ymc1 = dyaddown(M, 1, 'c'); ymr1 = dyaddown(M, 1, 'r');
comment: Sig: y = dyaddown(x[, ODD][, type]). Dyadic downsample by 2. ODD=0 default → keep even-indexed; ODD=1 → keep odd-indexed. For matrices, type ∈ {c (default, columns), r (rows), m (both)}. Bug fix 2026-05-08: matrix path silently flattened to a 1-D vector + ignored the type arg. tol=0 (integer-stable on integer inputs).
